HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP MARCH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

2. Which statement about Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha as rumours only.
   B. Explain Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha.
   D. Say Themes in African History and Citizenship 2.3 Social, Economic and Political cha never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Name the president
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Replace the compass rose

4. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Plan income and spending wisely

5. Which statement about Human developmen ts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human developmen ts in Africa.
   B. Treat Human developmen ts in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Say Human developmen ts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Human developmen ts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Which statement about Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   C. Treat Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the National Government of Kenya.

7. Which statement about Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social and Economic Development and challenges in independent Africa.

8. Which statement about Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya.
   B. Say Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Contemporary migrations, settlements and expansion in Kenya as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   D. Say Critical Issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.

10. Which statement about Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Major Economic developments and challenges in Kenya since independence.

11. Which statement about African Civilisations is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say African Civilisations never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing African Civilisations.
   C. Treat African Civilisations as rumours only.
   D. Explain African Civilisations with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

13. Which statement about Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya.
   C. Explain Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Implementation of the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.

14. Which statement about Colonialism in Contemporary Society is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)

   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonialism in Contemporary Society.
   C. Treat Colonialism in Contemporary Society as rumours only.

16. Which statement about External Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
